# Third-Party Notices (Bundle Folder)

This folder exists to make it easy to bundle third-party license texts when you
eventually distribute Simple-Sim (for example as an internal release bundle,
USB handover, installer, or container image).

Important:
- The files under `licenses/` are **generic license texts** (templates).
- For any real distribution, you must include the **package-specific** license
  texts and required notices for the exact versions you ship (including
  transitive dependencies).

See also: `../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`
